title: Exports include only the enabled columns, in the canonical on-screen order
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Hide two default columns (e.g. Category, Margin %) and enable a hidden one (e.g. Units Returned).
2. Download the CSV and read its column headers in order.
3. Download the PDF and read its columns in order.
custom_expected:
1. Both exports contain ONLY the currently enabled columns - the hidden ones are absent.
2. Columns appear in the CANONICAL order (the fixed on-screen order) - the re-enabled Units Returned sits right after Units Sold, NOT appended at the end.
3. The export mirrors the visible grid.
